cases.title: Initial Page Load State
cases.description: Verify that upon initial page load, 'progress-circle-1' has the 'active' class, all other circles lack it, 'progress-bar' has a width of '0%', 'prev-button' is disabled, and 'next-button' is enabled.

cases.title: Next Button Navigation and Progress Update
cases.description: Verify that clicking the 'Next' button marks the next progress circle as active, updates the 'progress-bar' width proportionally using the formula, enables the 'Prev' button, and disables the 'Next' button when the last circle is reached.

cases.title: Prev Button Navigation and Rapid Clicking Edge Case
cases.description: Verify that clicking the 'Prev' button removes the 'active' class from the current circle, decreases the progress bar width proportionally, disables the 'Prev' button when returning to the first circle, and handles rapid clicks gracefully without going below 0% width or deactivating the first circle.

cases.title: Tracker Boundary Constraints across Four Circles
cases.description: Verify that the progress tracker correctly maintains four circles, correctly disables 'Prev' at circle 1 and 'Next' at circle 4, and prevents navigation beyond these bounds while maintaining button states and visual indicators.

opinions.feedback: All test cases are well-defined, distinct, and adequately cover the requirements without any blockers.
All test cases and expected behaviors align correctly with the specified requirements.

analysis.analysis: e2edev_bench_52-R-1: Testable behavior: Initial page load state. Normal path: 'progress-circle-1' has class 'active', 'progress-circle-2' through '4' do not have 'active', 'progress-bar' has width '0%', 'prev-button' is disabled, 'next-button' is enabled. Boundaries: Exactly 4 circles. e2edev_bench_52-R-2: Testable behavior: Navigation via 'Next' button and general progression. Normal path: Clicking 'Next' adds 'active' to the subsequent circle, updates progress bar width using formula ((active - 1) / (total - 1)) * 100%, enables/disables 'Prev' and 'Next' appropriately. Abnormal/Edge paths: Clicking 'Next' when the last circle is active. e2edev_bench_52-R-3: Testable behavior: Navigation via 'Prev' button and rapid clicking. Normal path: Clicking 'Prev' removes 'active' from the current circle, updates progress bar width proportionally, updates button states. Abnormal paths: Rapid clicks on 'Prev' when already at the first circle; boundary condition ensures 'progress-circle-1' remains active and progress bar width does not drop below 0%. e2edev_bench_52-R-4: Testable behavior: Tracker constraints and overall integrity across 4 circles. Normal path: Steps navigate between 1 and 4. Boundaries: Attempts to navigate before circle 1 or after circle 4 must be blocked, preserving button disabled states and visual integrity. e2edev_bench_52-R-5: Testable behavior: Last circle state and button toggling. Normal path: 'Next' button disables on 'progress-circle-4', 'Prev' button enables/disables based on 'progress-circle-1' being active. Boundaries: Prevents navigation beyond bounds and guarantees correct visual feedback and button states at all times.
